description: This file is a shell script that sets up and runs various Git repository tests, primarily focusing on commit message content, verbose mode, diff inclusion/exclusion, and configuration effect on commit outputs. It automates testing scenarios related to Git commit messages and diff display handling.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates a script file with provided content.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs commands, and checks output.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in the output.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets a global git configuration for testing.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
